name: ai-proposal-writer-anna
tagline: Craft, customize, and export professional AI-generated project proposals in minutes.
description:
AI Proposal Writer is an end-to-end proposal generation and contract scoping platform purpose-built for digital agencies, software consultancies, freelance developers, and creative studios.

Transform complex project briefs into comprehensive, professionally formatted client proposals in minutes using Anna's native AI sampling and deep workflow orchestration.

### Key Capabilities & Workflow

1. Guided 4-Step Scoping Wizard:
- Step 1: Project & Client Overview — Client identity, project name, industry category, timeline, target delivery dates, and engagement budget.
- Step 2: Objectives & Core Deliverables — High-level project aims, specific measurable milestones, technical deliverables, and success metrics.
- Step 3: Technology Architecture & Team Allocation — Full technical stack selection, infrastructure dependencies, required skillsets, and assigned team roles.
- Step 4: Engagement Model & Investment Structure — Milestone-based fee schedules, payment terms, warranties, revision policies, and legal intellectual property provisions.

2. AI-Powered Proposal Engine:
- Instant generation of complete multi-page proposals structured with executive summaries, problem statements, proposed technical solutions, delivery milestones, risk mitigation matrices, and commercial terms.
- Powered by high-speed Executa reverse sampling via the Anna Host LLM.

3. Granular Inline Editing & Section Regeneration:
- Interactive proposal workbench with full inline Markdown editing across all sections.
- Targeted AI regeneration: refine individual sections (e.g. expand tech stack, add strict payment terms, shorten executive summary) without re-generating the entire proposal.

4. Client-Ready PDF Export & Storage:
- One-click PDF generation with clean corporate typography, formatted tables, section numbering, and executive headers.
- Persistent local draft storage via Anna's isolated host storage API, allowing teams to safely save, duplicate, and revisit working proposals anytime.

5. Secure, Sandboxed & Private:
- Zero external third-party API keys required. All AI sampling runs securely through your Anna agent runtime.
